## Hinge question {#fm4-hinge .fm-slide }

```{=html}
<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="4" class="hinge fm-hinge"><p class="hinge-question">$5000 is invested at 12% p.a., compounded monthly, for two years. Which expression gives the final balance?</p><div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div><div class="choices"><button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span><span data-math="5000(1.12)^2">5000(1.12)^2</span></span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span><span data-math="5000(1.12)^{24}">5000(1.12)^{24}</span></span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span><span data-math="5000(1.01)^2">5000(1.01)^2</span></span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span><span data-math="5000(1.01)^{24}">5000(1.01)^{24}</span></span></button></div><div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly. On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div><div class="hinge-explanation" hidden>4. The monthly rate is 1%, and two years contain 24 monthly periods.</div></div>
```

::: notes
Additional diagnostic question. Default 60 seconds. Students begin with a fist on their chest, think independently, and show 1–4 fingers simultaneously on your verbal “show” cue. Collect responses before revealing. Timer expiry does not reveal the answer.

Correct answer: 4.
1: assumes annual compounding.
2: counts months but applies the annual rate each month.
3: converts the rate but leaves the period count in years.

Ready: ask students to identify both conversions for semi-annual compounding, then proceed.
Divided: label “rate per month” and “number of months” on a two-year timeline and re-poll.
Further explanation needed: work through one year as twelve 1% periods; then extend to two years and re-poll.
:::
